html:
I've been wondering about the fates of several countries in the Second Renaissance-verse, we know what happens to for example China, US, UK (the big dogs)

What happens to Egypt, more specifically what happens to the dictatorship of el-Sisi, does Egypt ever get real real democracy, or is it doomed to be dominated by fundamentalists or military officials.

What happens to Ukraine? It seems likely that comedian Volodomyr Zelensky will win the election on 21 April, how is his presidency seen in the future? Will he actually deliver on his very vague policies (something that i doubt) or will he be just another corrupt Ukrainian president? I also saw that Poland annexes a portion of western Ukraine, how does Kiev respond to that? Is there a war that Ukraine loses or is it more of a Crimea 2014 situation?

you mentioned Assad fleeing to Russia in exile, I assume that he gets overthrown by a faction of the Military. What is the overall future of Syria, say 10-30 years (before WWIII) from now. I think the generation of children who grew up during the Civil War will radically impact Syria's society and politics

I also wonder how France and Germany both are impacted by the 2027 revolutions, I have a feeling that French voters will elect Marion Marechal (niece of Marine le pen) in the elections of that year..

Sweden is a mostly irrelevant country on the international stage, and I know that it's politics are not interesting, but do you think someone like Jimmie Åkesson (leader of nationalist Sweden Democrats) can get elected in the 2026 or 2030 election (aftermath of 2027 revolutions)?

I'm really sorry for the big wall of text, but i hope you dont mind me askking,<ac_metadata title="future of several countries"> </ac_metadata>
